# LiFx Knowledge Base

> LiFx is a Detours-based extension framework for the Life is Feudal: Your Own dedicated server (Steam appid 320850). This file is a compact, greppable index of the docs/ tree for AI agents: every page appears once under its domain with a one-line summary, status, tags, and key RE symbols. Statuses are: verified | re | design | ops | reference | superseded. RVAs are relative to image base 0x140000000 (server = ddctd_cm_yo_server.exe). Read contributing.md before adding or editing a page. The human-facing master index is README.md.

## Start here

- [Architecture](architecture.md): What LiFx is, source-tree map, what is wired vs. a framework hook, and the naming scheme. | status: reference | tags: lifx-framework, architecture
- [Conventions](conventions.md): Hook naming + file-layout conventions and the step-by-step recipe for adding a new Detours hook. | status: reference | tags: conventions, hooks, naming
- [Build](build.md): Build on Linux with clang-cl + lld-link + xwin (no Windows VM); plus the Windows LiFx.sln path. | status: reference | tags: build, clang-cl, xwin, lld-link
- [Loader and injection](loader_and_injection.md): How LiFx gets into the server process: pdh.dll proxy, deployment layout, Wine WINEDLLOVERRIDES, verification commands. | status: reference | tags: loader, pdh-proxy, injection, wine
- [Reverse engineering setup](reverse_engineering.md): Ghidra setup, the LifxExport.java / LifxEventVtables.java analysis scripts, and the artifact files they produce. | status: reference | tags: ghidra, scripts, tooling

- [NetEvent ABI](netevent_abi.md): Settled negative result that no per-class pack/unpack exists in any static vtable; serialization is runtime-built, so SectorHandoff must implement its own. | status: re | tags: netevent, classrep, torque, serialization, sector-handoff | key: NETCLASSREP_ADD=0x418C40, SERVERUUIDEVENT_SEND=0x4E7370, DAT_140BC00B0, FUN_140542CC0, FUN_140542630, sink@0x140783118
- [Dispatcher wire format](dispatcher_wire_format.md): YO cmDispUnitManager is a party/guild membership sync channel (three uint32 IDs per opcode), not a character/object handoff; sector handoff needs a new NetEvent on the same NetConnection infra. | status: re | tags: dispatcher, net-event, party-sync, server-to-server, wire-format | key: SERVERUUIDEVENT_SEND 0x4E7370, NETCLASSREP_ADD 0x418C40, parseDispatcherReply 0x3CC860, processServerRequest 0x3CA570, DspUtil lookup 0x5367A0, script-binding registry 0x1407338B0
- [NPC / Animal class hierarchy](npc_class_hierarchy.md): RTTI-verified Player->NPCS::Base->{AnimatedNPC->Animal} & ->PlayerBased->NPCDecorative tree, proving native combat nodes gate on Animals::Animal (key "animal") not AnimatedNPC, so NPCDecorative needs custom "npcbase"-keyed perception nodes. | status: verified | tags: rtti, npc, animal, ai, vtable, class-hierarchy | key: NPCS_BASE_CTOR 0x2E2C10, NPCDECORATIVE_CTOR 0x2E46B0, NPCDEC_VTABLE 0x7E3D08, ANIMAL_VTABLE 0x798AA0, EnemyInRange::process 0x1941A0, find animal 0x190D70 / npcbase 0x190E90
- [Character AI & equip-over-ghost RE](character_ai_re.md): RE of the A2a character-backed hostile NPC: NPCDecorative carries both the charStats/equip/death layout and the AI tree/move-engine, driven by custom npcbase nodes with a vtable-slot-patched packUpdate equip-over-ghost bolt-on. | status: re | tags: npc-ai, equip-over-ghost, packupdate, charstats, behavior-tree | key: NPCS_BASE_CTOR=0x2E2C10, NPCDEC_VTABLE=0x7E3D08, NPCDEC_PACKUPDATE_SLOT=54, SHAPEBASE_PACKUPDATE=0x0FC8B0, charStats@+0xAA8, NPC_AI_TREE_OFF=0x24B8
- [AI behaviors & spawning](ai_and_spawning.md): The 42-node AI behavior-tree catalog, Animals::SpawnControl XML system, Torque trigger callbacks, animation pipeline, and spawn recipes. | status: verified | tags: ai, behavior-tree, spawning, animation, triggers
- [Animal data model](animal_data_model.md): Live _c world DB has no animal_*; combat is AnimalData-datablock-driven, loot is recipe/skinning, types register in-engine via LiFx::registerObjectsTypes. | status: re | tags: animal, objects-types, datablock, loot, spawn, mysql | key: CREATE_ANIMAL 0x195FD0, ANIMAL_GET_DATABLOCK_BY_TYPE 0x18C790, ANIMAL_CREATE_CORPSE 0x18A370, ANIMAL_MGR_REMOVE 0x196850, CHARSTATS_DEATH_TRIGGER_SLOT 0x130, death router 0x3BE890
- [On-demand animal spawning](animal_spawn.md): RE doc on spawning Animals::Animal via createAnimal (0x195FD0) + the death-to-tombstone charStats bind; all RVAs/offsets verified against sources and live source, one byte-arithmetic nit fixed. | status: re | tags: animals, spawning, hostile-npc, tombstone, hooks, charstats | key: CREATE_ANIMAL 0x195FD0, ANIMALS_MANAGER_GLOBAL_RVA 0xB80C90, ANIMAL_GET_DATABLOCK_BY_TYPE 0x18C790, ANIMAL_CREATE_CORPSE 0x18A370, CHARSTATS_DEATH_TRIGGER_SLOT 0x130, kNpcCharStatsVtableRva 0x7E4388
- [Bandit combat: held weapon, melee strike & stamina](bandit_combat.md): Make the #154 bandit fight as an armed humanoid — held-weapon render via Mount_movable_object (id 556, image slot 6), native Animals::Animal::endAttack cone hit-scan dealing real wounds, the AI-driven swing fix (alternating Attack_Fast/Power defeated the anti-restart guard), and a player-calibrated stamina pool (cost scaled by the real weapon) pacing the swing. Real soft-stamina is a 1e6 fixed-point vital pool behind virtual accessors with no NPC regen tick, so it is left untouched. cci-free. | status: re | tags: hostile-npc, bandit, combat, melee, weapon, stamina, animation, hooks | key: MOUNT_MOVABLE_OBJECT 0xEBA30, ANIMAL_END_ATTACK 0x18A4D0, ANIMAL_SWING 0x18B950, SetAnimByIndex 0x2E2520, SETANIM 0x2E2A90, APPLY_HIT 0x51F030, HIT_DESC_BUILDER 0xA41D0, ON_SOFT_STAMINA_EXHAUSTED 0x96D00, weaponImageId 556, this+0x24F0 WeaponData, this+0x2530 datablock, WeaponData+0x2390 dmgLevel
- [Offline character load](offline_char_load.md): Build a fully DB-loaded CmCharacterInfo offline from a bare charId (no GameConnection) via CHARACTER_LOAD_INMEM, on the engine main thread, as the foundation for the #145 worn-loot tombstone. | status: re | tags: character-info, equipment, lootstone, main-thread, hostile-npc | key: CHARACTER_LOAD_INMEM 0x1BB290, CCI_FIELD_INIT_CTOR 0x1B9C50, CM_INVENTORY_PLAYER_INIT 0x2900B0, EQUIP_LOAD_FROM_DB 0x1F2760, IS_MAIN_THREAD 0x407EF0, SPAWN_LOOTSTONE 0x102570
- [Lootstone item injection](lootstone_injection.md): cci/connection-gated death-loot paths and the shipped cci-free fix: SQL-move the bandit's char-container item rows into its grave container, then force a live container reload. | status: re | tags: loot, containers, death-pipeline, hostile-npc, sql | key: SPAWN_LOOTSTONE 0x102570, CHARSTATS_DEATH_TRIGGER_SLOT 0x130, Zed_is_dead 0x89660, CONTAINER_TRYINIT 0x299140, DB_GET_WORLD_CONN 0x54CAF0, DB_EXEC_FORMATTED 0x0884F0
- [Character HP](character_hp.md): LiF HP architecture investigation: what writes/propagates, dead-ends to skip, and the empirical hook-on-real-damage approach. | status: re | tags: character-hp, damage, hooks
- [Per-player pacifist (PvP-off) toggle](pacifist_pvp_toggle.md): Lifx::setPacifist(charID) flags a player so any weapon deals zero damage to other players (generalised believer-weapon behaviour); enforced in the ONEPUNCHMAN damage calc, zeroing outDamage when a flagged attacker hits a player, with charID->charStats registry-validated identity. Melee-confirmed, ranged-unverified, in-memory state. | status: re | tags: combat, pvp, damage, onepunchman, lifx-api, believer-weapon | key: ONEPUNCHMAN=0x0A4BF0, Hooks::OnePunchMan, kCharIdOffOnCharStats=0x109C, kCharStatsToPlayerDelta=0xAA8, Hooks::VitalParams::LookupCharStats, Lifx::setPacifist/isPacifist/dumpPacifist
- [Battlezones (starting-zone land)](battlezones.md): RE of Lands::BattleZoneLand: createBattleZone is a real engine TS fn, the active-starting-zone snap-back (Player::_checkSteps -> teleportTo, gated on +0x30 subtype/+0x34 active) is the real "lock-in", and the Battle-Totem prep-clamp is unimplemented in the YO server. | status: re | tags: lands, battlezone, containment, lifx-api, torquescript, movement | key: Lands::BattleZoneLand, createBattleZone, deleteBattleZone, printBattleZones, Lands::Manager::createBattleZoneLand, Lands::Manager::isActiveStartingZone
- [Outposts](outposts.md): Outpost/claim radius system RE and the proximity rules between outposts, monuments, and personal claims. | status: re | tags: outposts, claims, radius, proximity
- [Bloomery & furnace/recipe system](bloomery.md): Full furnace/recipe system: recalcTick walkthrough, the 59-row proc-descriptor table, bloomery whitelist, kiln/vostaskus cycles, and hook recipes. | status: verified | tags: bloomery, furnace, recipes, crafting
- [Craftwork working-containers (tanning tub)](craftwork_containers.md): The tanning tub is the last unhooked craftwork leaf: type 472 driven by the compiled WorkingContainer class under CmCraftworkManager (sibling of the hooked AbstractCraftworkFurnace family), verb UseTanningTube id 85 gated on the literal object_type_id 472 (no parent walk); output ResultItemID + quantity are engine-computed not data (working_containers DB table is runtime state only), so a 2nd batch-size variant needs a hook; CmCraftworkManager is a generic type-dispatched loader so the hook is a reusable timed-container seam. No RVAs recorded yet. | status: re | tags: craftwork, working-container, tanning-tub, hooks, objects-types | key: type 472, WorkingContainer, CmCraftworkManager, UseTanningTube id 85, working_containers, FURNACE_PROC_DESC_LOOKUP 0x1DB7C0 (furnace-only), Type::hasParent 0x27EB30
- [YO server engine hooks](YO_SERVER_HOOKS.md): Config-driven in-memory hooks for modded Your Own servers (extra farmable crops + gatherable limit, datablock id range, greenhouse/stable aliases, herb-garden time gate, workshop quality buff, cart places, well water) with the RVA table and how-to. | status: re | tags: hooks, farming, crafting, datablock, aliases, workshop-buff | key: BasePlantImp::_onDoPerform 0x3A4550, cropMap 0xB98D10, GATHERABLE_LIMIT 0x3796D8/0x379758/0x3797C8/0x379A00, TypeStorage ctor 0xCEC86, loadObjects 0x1D8E20, use entry 0x1D91D0, craftWithDevice 0x1E4B10, checkExceptionalChance 0x1E46B0, PutMovableInCart 0x37E1D0, cart max 0x81D3E0, GetWater 0x39F780, gather 0x37B090, checkContainerLimits 0x1AC440

- [Encrypted assets (LFXE)](dts_encryption.md): LFXE encrypted assets: the universal FileStream decrypt hook, the ChaCha20 container format, the key path, and the packer. | status: verified | tags: lfxe, encryption, chacha20, filestream, assets

## Client

- [Qt / QtWebEngine & HTTPS](qt_and_https.md): A loose-DLL Qt 5.15.2 / Chromium 83 overlay binds against the unmodified 5.9-linked yo_cm_client.exe and runs through to in-world play; the Qt5Network OpenSSL path needs 1.1.x (not 1.0.2/libeay32). | status: re | tags: client, qt, webengine, https, openssl, dll-swap | key: GuiMainMenuMultiplayerWindow, GameTSCtrl("PlayGui"), GID:0x02000003, Qt5WebEngineCore.dll, libcrypto-1_1-x64, libssl-1_1-x64
- [Client 9x9 grid-size patch](client_grid_patch.md): Verified RE record of the community 0x189554 0x03->0x09 client grid-clamp byte-patch; documented only as a hook target, never to be applied (no-exe-patching rule). | status: re | tags: client, exe-patch, world-grid, federation, handoff | key: 0x189554, yo_cm_client.exe, CLIENT_OPEN_FILE_STREAM (0x61E620), 0x140000000, ddctd_cm_yo_server.exe, Con::Evaluate

## Design & proposals

- [Hostile-NPC AI path comparison](hostile-npc-ai-path-comparison.md): Path comparison for human-shaped hostile NPCs: keep NPCDecorative + custom "npcbase" nodes (Path 2, chosen) vs re-platform onto Animals::Animal (Path 1), with the NPCDecorative-not-in-vital-sim finding and #125 tombstone/worn-loot decision. | status: design | tags: hostile-npc, npc-ai, behavior-tree, npcdecorative, worn-loot, reverse-engineering | key: EQUIP_ACCESSOR=0x28BD30, NPCS_BASE_CTOR=0x2E2C10, NPCDECORATIVE_CREATE=0x2E4AB0, AI_TREE_PROCESS=0x154020, SPAWN_LOOTSTONE=0x102570, ON_DEATH_HAPPENS=0x0FB390
- [Sector handoff design](sector_handoff_design.md): Design contract for a new SectorHandoff NetEvent (wire shape, state machine, DB-ownership, DLL hook surface) — verified accurate against cm_offsets.h and the dispatcher/netevent RE docs; no changes needed. | status: design | tags: sector-handoff, net-events, dispatcher, world-stitching, mysql | key: NETCLASSREP_ADD=0x418C40, SERVERUUIDEVENT_SEND=0x4E7370, FUN_140542CC0 (postNetEvent), FUN_140542630 (drainer), FUN_140541720 (eventReadPacket), FUN_140417770 (findClass)
- [Caravan event proposal](caravan_event_proposal.md): Design+RE plan for a server-side road-following self-defending AI cart-horse: offline substance-weighted A* over geo_patch road tiles emits waypoints, a LiFx WalkWaypoints custom behavior-tree node (built on the verified #120/#122/#124 node ABI) walks them. | status: design | tags: ai-behavior-tree, caravan, road-following, pathfinding, custom-node | key: AI_GET_NODE_FACTORY 0x153860, AI_REGISTER_NODE 0x153950, AI_CREATE_BY_NAME 0x153760, AI_LOAD_BEHAVIOR_XML 0x153B80, getAiData 0x1530D0 (node+0x28), GoToPosition::process 0x2E5C70

## Conventions & contributing

- [Conventions](conventions.md): Hook naming + file-layout conventions and the step-by-step recipe for adding a new Detours hook. | status: reference | tags: conventions, hooks, naming
- [Contributing to the knowledge base](contributing.md): How to add and maintain pages in this knowledge base; the front-matter schema, status legend, and the memory-mirror rule. | status: reference | tags: contributing, front-matter, status-legend, memory-mirror
- [Project principles & hard rules](principles.md): The two project-lead hard rules — never byte-patch the client/server binaries (mod via pdh-proxy + Detours DLL injection or loose .cs only) and keep public docs to the TorqueScript-exposed API while engine internals/DLL name stay private — with supporting offsets and gate test. | status: reference | tags: no-exe-patch, dll-injection, public-docs, policy, detours | key: CON_EVALUATE=0x406A50, CON_INTERNAL_PRINTF=0x405090, OPEN_FILE_STREAM=0x44A2C0, CLIENT_OPEN_FILE_STREAM=0x61E620 (comment), 0x189554 0x03->0x09 yo_cm_client.exe, 4ba5cb5e.dll

## Public API

These mirror to ../ghdocs/docs/ (Rampart-Games-Limited/LiFxRampart) and document only the public TorqueScript-exposed API; engine internals and the DLL name stay out.

- [Players](../ghdocs/docs/players.md): TS API: read/write a player HP, apply damage/heal, knock out, kill. | status: reference | tags: ts-api, players, hp
- [Effects](../ghdocs/docs/effects.md): TS API: modify an active effect on a Player (expiry, extend, clear, force a HUD refresh). | status: reference | tags: ts-api, effects, hud
- [Timers](../ghdocs/docs/timers.md): TS API: override the post-respawn Resurrected debuff duration, globally or per player. | status: reference | tags: ts-api, timers, respawn
- [Outposts](../ghdocs/docs/outposts.md): TS API: default/live outpost radius, production retargeting, proximity rules. | status: reference | tags: ts-api, outposts, radius
- [NPCs](../ghdocs/docs/npcs.md): TS API: spawn NPCs, keep them respawned near players, bind appearance/equipment. | status: reference | tags: ts-api, npcs, spawn, equipment
- [Dispatcher](../ghdocs/docs/dispatcher.md): TS API: move characters / forward frames between server peers for sector handoff (experimental). | status: reference | tags: ts-api, dispatcher, sector-handoff, experimental
